Existing Roles

The system has four user roles:

buyer

vendor

courier

admin

Current Issue

All users (including couriers) are currently being stored and treated as regular users in the profiles table.

I already created a couriers table, but:

Courier registrations are not being inserted into it

Courier approval logic is not enforced

Couriers are accessing the buyer dashboard instead of a delivery dashboard

Goal

Integrate the couriers table properly into the existing system and enforce admin approval before courier privileges are granted.

Required System Changes
1. Courier Registration (Existing Users)

Users can become couriers in two existing flows:

During initial signup (selecting “Register as Courier”)

After signup (logged-in users go to Profile → Settings → Become a Courier)

When a user registers as a courier:

Insert or update a record in the couriers table

Link it to the user via user_id

Set status = 'pending'

Do NOT grant courier permissions yet

2. Admin Review & Approval

Admin users must be able to:

Log in to the existing Admin Dashboard

See all couriers where status = 'pending'

View pending couriers in:

Overview Panel

Logistics Panel

Admin actions:

Approve courier → set status = 'approved'

Decline courier → set status = 'declined' (optional reason)

3. Role & Dashboard Enforcement

Dashboard access rules:

buyer → Buyer Dashboard

vendor → Vendor Dashboard

courier:

pending → Buyer dashboard + “Awaiting Admin Approval”

declined → Buyer dashboard + decline message

approved → Courier / Delivery Dashboard

On login

On page refresh

On protected API endpoints

Pending or declined couriers from accessing delivery routes

Vendor logic remains unchanged

Ensure courier changes do not break vendor flows

Ensure:

Proper foreign key between profiles and couriers

Database schema (if any)
